scope: 20 formal competitions; identify native or separately verified per-shot nonpenalty xG sources, preserving missing cohorts
audit_population: All 77 pre-existing October schedule identities from #64, with a paired 25-fixture age comparison fixed by its original eligibility ledger. No new predictions or retrospective model selection from #64 results. Other dated sources inventory separately. Current captures may inform only cutoffs after actual receipt, with no new research issue.
cutoff: actual kickoff minus 60 minutes for both arms / teams. Include only same competition 2026/27 senior male regular league, strictly prior completed fixtures in order. Provider-specific per-team/event IDs and reliable two-sided proof. Exclude future collection, unknown date, mismatched opponent and incomplete penalty attribution. Use a complete fixture calendar as an independent denominator; calendar observed after cutoff may audit expected slots but cannot be used as a past model input. Confirm capture no later than cutoff; a whole-vintage hash confirmed by an already-existing prior independent receipt is distinguished from a newly generated local capture.
coverage_metrics: Show original fixture slots, identity-admitted and comparison populations, exact six completed prior fixture ids per team, count 0..6, both 6/6, missing slots and distinct target team latest observed age benchmark. No arbitrary trailing-day threshold: the most recent actual six count, even when there is an international break. No mixing different provider xG within one window or substituting total xG for nonpenalty xG.
one_change_if_ready: Within historical source-timed fixtures where a real paired recent six exists, compare same existing six-match goals/xG regression and otherwise identical regression replacing prior xGF/xGA with native nonpenalty xGF/xGA (unchanged alpha=0.01; same training seasons 2020/21..2024/25, one fit per league, no outcome-based choices). Shared cutoff, unchanged model, exact fallback when incomplete, report coverage on whole roster. If recent evidence covers too few to infer anything, report available diagnostic/cases only. If no eligible pair, measure time coverage and provide a reusable private local ingestion + audit path instead. No new forward queue, R7 or #64 fitting.
outputs: no GitHub publishing, no official route, freeze, queue, live policy, production weights or scheduled task changes
